name: What are common signs that my gate needs repair?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my gate needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs that your gate needs repair include difficulty opening or closing, unusual noises during operation, visible damage to the gate structure or components, sagging, or issues with sensors or safety features. Ignoring these signs can lead to further damage, potential safety hazards, or complete gate failure. Frasheski Construction can assess your gate's condition in the Berkeley and East Bay areas to determine the necessary repairs, whether it's for a residential driveway gate or a commercial security gate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Difficulty opening, unusual noises, visible damage, or sensor issues indicate a need for gate repair. Prompt attention prevents further damage and ensures safety.
